Act as a professional portfolio designer and web
developer. Help me build a modern, interactive
portfolio that I can share with companies and
recruiters to showcase my skills, projects,
education, interests, and career goals. Start by
asking me questions about my background,
technical skills, achievements, projects, and the
roles I want to pursue. Use my answers to create
a portfolio that reflects my personality while
presenting me professionally. Organize the
content into clear sections and highlight my
strongest projects with their goals, my
contributions, technologies used, and results
where available. Create a unique visual identity
with clean layouts, readable typography, smooth
animations, and responsive design across
mobile, tablet, and desktop. Make the portfolio
easy to navigate and include working links and a
clear way for recruiters to explore my work and
contact me through a method I approve. Do not
invent achievements, skills, experience, or
results. Include only information I approve for
public sharing and never expose sensitive
personal details, credentials, or confidential
information. Build a functional MVP rather than
a static mockup. Before presenting the final
version, test the main interactions, navigation,
responsiveness, and content accuracy, fix any
issues you find, and summarize what is ready to
share and what still needs attention.
